summary: Install-only ceiling help for A Creative Touch at Hamilton Farm (10/24): load-in at 11am, then 5 chandeliers and a full dance-floor perimeter garland on an ~11-ft lip, all with premade smilax. About 31 work units ≈ 15.5 person-hours on site in a 5-hour window, so 3 people. Strike priced as an add-on.

steps.label: Arrive Hamilton Farm, check in, find load-in door

logistics_notes: 8–12 ft A-frames are enough for an 11-ft lip under a 12-ft ceiling.
Everything must be off the floor by ~4:15 so the room can turn for the 5pm reception.
OPTIONAL STRIKE (not in total): team of 3, 9:15pm → 1:30am (4.25 hrs) removing chandelier + perimeter garland (≈45% of install time) = $828.75 + van $70, +8% = ~$970. Same day, so no extra base fee.
reasoning: 5 chandeliers × 2 units + ~96 ft perimeter × 1.5 per 10 ft (~14 units) + load-in ~4 + hardware/wood pieces ~3 ≈ 31 units.
Premade garland installs at ~2 units/ph → ~15.5 person-hours on site.
Window 11:00am → ~4:00pm (5 hrs) → 3 people. With 2 people it's ~7.75 hrs on site and runs into the ceremony/reception turn.
Donna is on site; if she or her team can work the perimeter alongside us, 2 JS people can work (see leaner option).
red_flags: Exact perimeter length unknown (~96 ft assumed for a ~24×24 dance floor): +/- 1 hr per 30 ft.
Venue rules on attaching to the lip/lighting and COI are TBD, 9 days out.
Short timeline + injured captains: she's in a pinch.
